title: Commit to Love
description: Ten requests. Three agents. Six users and absolutely no romantic guarantees.

Adding profiles. Relationship status defaults to merge conflict.

Added dark mode. Light mode was a red flag.

events.output: FAIL: everyone swiped left on themselves.

events.content: export const swipeLabels = { right: "Green flag", left: "Java" };
